essence: The origin and dissolution of the pure path call for an account that does not presuppose an ordinary locus or agent.
The threefold knowledge-weapons require an account of both their origin from a source and their return.
Consciousness does not act by means of transformation to produce that action without remainder.
The present argument appeals to a prior detailed demonstration as already established.
A manyfold division of the path is admissible as imagined on account of particularity due to effect.
